site.name: THE INTELLIGENCE
site.subtitle: The official student newspaper
site.heroTitle: A NEW YEAR. A NEW OPERATION.
site.heroText: Welcome to The Intelligence — a student newspaper designed to keep the whole school informed, involved and curious about what is happening around campus.
site.alert: BREAKING: STUDENT LIFE IS NOW OFFICIALLY UNDER INVESTIGATION.

clubs.title: Basketball Club
clubs.text: Improve your game, compete and meet other students. Tuesdays after school.
clubs.details: Meet in the Sports Hall every Tuesday after school. Bring your PE kit and water.

clubs.title: Art & Design
clubs.text: Drawing, painting, design and creative projects. Beginners are welcome.
clubs.details: The creative department is open to anyone who wants to make something.

clubs.title: Science Club
clubs.text: Experiments, competitions and science beyond the normal classroom mission.
clubs.details: Experiments, challenges and science competitions. Ask your Science teacher for the next meeting time.

hallOfFame.title: Science Investigation of the Month
hallOfFame.text: An outstanding investigation into renewable energy, selected for clear reasoning, presentation and originality.

hallOfFame.title: Writing of the Week
hallOfFame.text: A creative short story selected from this month's English submissions.

riddles.title: Riddle of the Week
riddles.question: I speak without a mouth and hear without ears. I have no body, but I come alive with wind. What am I?

riddles.title: Challenge Riddle
riddles.question: The more you take, the more you leave behind. What am I?

riddles.title: Brain Teaser
riddles.question: I have cities but no houses, forests but no trees, and water but no fish. What am I?

riddles.title: Lateral Puzzle
riddles.question: What has a neck but no head?

entries.clue: To motivate or fill with enthusiasm (7)
